title: Service Company Placement Sprint
philosophy: One ordered journey. Diagnose → learn → practice → assess → remediate. Mastery is server-graded only. Dashboard and Academy share this spine.

sprints.name: Sprint 0 — Map your gaps
sprints.goal: Complete diagnostic so the plan is evidence-based

sprints.name: Sprint 1 — Programming foundations
sprints.goal: Variables through loops, functions, arrays, strings — then a code lab

sprints.name: Sprint 2 — Quant core (NQT-heavy)
sprints.goal: High-frequency aptitude for TCS / Infy / Wipro / Cognizant

sprints.name: Sprint 3 — Reasoning core
sprints.goal: Series, coding-decoding, relations, direction, syllogisms, seating, puzzles

sprints.name: Sprint 4 — Verbal essentials
sprints.goal: Grammar and comprehension used in service papers

sprints.name: Sprint 5 — Coding + logic for service OA
sprints.goal: Pseudocode, DSA basics used in InfyTQ / NQT coding

sprints.name: Sprint 6 — CS interview floor
sprints.goal: DBMS + OOP so technical rounds are not a surprise

sprints.name: Sprint 7 — Company mocks + remediation
sprints.goal: Timed service-OA mocks; weak skills loop back to lessons
